family_reports.body: Our nephews and niece have been removed from our care, and placed back into an extremely abusive home. Lots of new allegations of abuse.
We are in constant worry mode for the safety of the children.

Flathead County Montana, all the attorneys, CPS workers and judges are friends. When we sought out hiring a private attorney, we were told by one "i have known the caseworker for years, I find it hard to believe she could be a problem?" My children were taken on lies. They still have not proven any of the accusations. Yet my rights will be terminated. In Montana family are suppose to be first to get the children. Our aunt who is a licensed foster home, has tried to get them since the beginning. But they were placed with a family that has been looking to adopt. We truly feel they were taken so they could be adopted.
